metin.SexyKO'da bulunan **Equipment View Siste: With the **Equipment View System** in SexyKO, you can inspect detailed information about a player's character in a single window.
metin.Sistem yalnızca karakterin üzerindeki it: The system doesn't just show the items on the character; it also shows **stat values, resistance info, active buffs and the inventory view** in detail.
metin.Bu sayede başka bir oyuncunun karakter y: This way you can inspect another player's character build much more thoroughly.
metin.İncelemek istediğiniz karaktere **sağ tı: **Right-click** the character you want to inspect.
metin.Bu işlemin ardından seçtiğiniz oyuncunun: After that, the selected player's detailed **Equipment / Ability** window opens.
metin.Bu ekran üzerinden karakterin birçok bil: On this screen you can see a lot of the character's information at once.
